title: 第1736章 先斩后奏便好第1735章 好好教训
slug: 横推九世诸位女帝一直在等我
content_zh:
“唉，真是麻烦。”
忆无情抬手按着眉心，轻轻揉按几分，眼底漫着浅浅的无奈，心头一阵头大。
这批万界石，是他特意筹备、留着用来重铸熔炼无双的核心材料。
此番熔炼并非他本意，而是昭宁特意叮嘱安排的。
昭宁之前说，要亲手为他熔炼重塑无双，当作一份专属的赠礼。
世间各类珍稀神材她皆无需，唯独特意嘱咐他多多收集万界石，作为熔炼无双的主材。
忆无情心底一直藏着几分疑惑。
无双本就是伴随他多年的禁忌古器，历经无数淬炼，早已趋近无瑕，锋芒与品相皆是顶尖。
这般近乎完美的神兵，竟还需要借助万界石熔炼重塑？
可无论他如何追问缘由，昭宁始终没有选择回答，只让他安心筹备，待到功成之日，一切自然揭晓。
忆无情便让雪夜前去与仙渺接洽商议，敲定细节，顺带调取足量的万界石以备熔炼所需。
仙渺向来大方通透，听闻用途后全然没有犹豫，直言自己囤积了海量万界石，任凭他随意取用，数量不限。
他曾好奇追问过这批万界石的来历，仙渺坦言，这是她昔日为修行一门顶级法则，耗费心力四处搜集而来。
待她功成圆满、法则大成，这批晶石便再无用处，一直封存闲置，还用来建造宫殿。
思绪收回，忆无情轻叹了一声，抬手取出冰凉剔透的通讯晶石，指尖轻点激活，语气平和开口：
“仙渺，听得到吗？”
晶石瞬间传来一阵灵动清甜的回响，仙渺软糯酥甜的嗓音骤然响起，裹挟着难以掩饰的激动与欣喜，雀跃至极：
“在的！
主人在的！
仙渺听得清清楚楚！”

她语气带着满满的期许与雀跃：“主人终于有空主动找仙渺说话啦？”
忆无情闻言下意识抬手摸了摸下巴，心底暗自失笑。
这声音……与看起来清冷矜贵、端庄疏离的仙渺有些不同。
嗓音软糯清甜，反差格外鲜明。
晶石那头的声音再次响起，带着几分狡黠的疑惑与期待：
“明天就是盛典宴会啦，我们明明很快就能见面了，主人现在就找我，是……想我了吗？”
言语间的雀跃与期盼几乎要溢出来。
忆无情无奈揉了揉发胀的眉心，抵不住这软糯的语气，温和应声：
“嗯，确实想你了，不过此番寻你，也有要事与你商议。”
“我就知道主人是有事要忙。”
仙渺轻笑一声，语气明媚柔软，满是贴心：
“不过只要主人亲口说想我，仙渺就已经特别开心了。”
“主人尽管说事就好，无论什么吩咐，仙渺一定尽数照做，绝不推辞。”
content_en:
"Oh, it's really troublesome."
Yi Qingqing raised her hand and pressed it between her eyebrows, rubbing it gently for a few minutes. There was a slight helplessness in her eyes, and her heart felt heavy.
This batch of Ten Thousand Realms Stones was specially prepared and reserved by him to be used to recast and smelt the core materials of Wushuang.
This smelting was not his original intention, but was specially arranged by Zhao Ning.
Zhao Ning said before that she would personally smelt and reshape Wushuang for him as an exclusive gift.
She had no need for all kinds of rare and divine materials in the world, but specifically asked him to collect more Ten Thousand Realms Stones as the main material for smelting Wushuang.
Yi Qingqing has always had some doubts hidden in her heart.
Wushuang was originally a taboo ancient artifact that had been with him for many years. After countless temperings, it had already become flawless, with top-notch sharpness and appearance.
Such a nearly perfect divine weapon actually needs to be smelted and reshaped with the help of the Ten Thousand Realms Stone?
But no matter how he asked for the reason, Zhao Ning never chose to answer, and just let him prepare with peace of mind, and everything will be revealed naturally when the success is achieved.
Yi Qingqing asked Xue Ye to go to discuss with Xian Miao, finalize the details, and also transfer enough Wanjie Stone to prepare for the smelting needs.
Xian Miao has always been generous and transparent. After hearing the use, he did not hesitate at all. He bluntly said that he had hoarded a large amount of Wanjie Stone, allowing him to use it at will, with no limit on the quantity.
He once curiously inquired about the origin of these Ten Thousand Realms Stones, and Xian Miao admitted that they were collected by her in order to practice a top-level law in the past.
When her achievements were completed and her laws were completed, these crystals were no longer useful and had been kept unused and used to build palaces.
With his thoughts retracted, Yi Qingqing sighed softly, raised his hand and took out the cold and clear communication crystal, activated it lightly with his fingertips, and spoke in a calm tone:
"Xianmiao, can you hear me?"
There was a smart and sweet echo from the crystal in an instant, and Xianmiao's soft and sweet voice suddenly sounded, wrapped in unconcealable excitement and joy, and she was extremely excited:
"Yes!
The master is here!
Xian Miao heard it clearly! "
Her tone was full of expectation and excitement: "Master finally has time to take the initiative to talk to Xianmiao?"
Hearing this, Yi Wuqing subconsciously raised his hand and touched his chin, laughing secretly in his heart.
This voice... is somewhat different from Xian Miao, who looks cold, dignified, dignified and distant.
The voice is soft, waxy and sweet, and the contrast is particularly sharp.
The voice on the other end of the crystal sounded again, with a bit of sly doubt and expectation:
"Tomorrow is the grand ceremony and banquet. We will meet soon. Master is looking for me now. Does he... miss me?"
The excitement and anticipation in his words almost overflowed.
Yi Qingqing helplessly rubbed her swollen brows, unable to resist the soft tone, and responded gently:
"Well, I do miss you, but I am looking for you this time and I have something important to discuss with you."
"I knew the master was busy with something."
Xian Miao chuckled, her tone bright and soft, full of caring:
"But as long as the master says he misses me, Xianmiao will be very happy."
"Master, just do whatever you say. No matter what you say, Xianmiao will definitely do it and never refuse."
